followUp.answer:
QBQuran Bytes guideHere’s a quick way to try it:
1. Read the verse once.
2. Select the covered word to reveal it, then hide it again.
3. Recall the word and mark a repetition with the arrow.

Three marks complete a loop. This demo doesn’t save progress.Try memorization practice ↗Copy
